blocks.title: IT Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)
blocks.subtitle: Keep Your IT Running. Always.
paragraphs: Reliable, proactive IT maintenance designed to keep your systems healthy, your team productive, and your business free from unexpected downtime. With True Line's AMC plans, your IT is in expert hands — every day of the year.

blocks.title: Why Your Business Needs an IT AMC
paragraphs: IT issues don't wait for business hours — and neither should your support. An Annual Maintenance Contract gives your business consistent, predictable IT care without the cost of hiring a full in-house team.

At True Line Technologies, our AMC plans cover everything from preventive maintenance and on-site visits to remote troubleshooting and emergency response. Whether you run a small office or a multi-branch enterprise, we tailor every contract to match your environment, your priorities, and your budget — so your IT is always one step ahead of problems, not chasing them.

items.title: Desktops, Laptops & Workstations
items.text: Hardware diagnostics, OS support, troubleshooting, and performance tuning for end-user devices.

items.title: Servers & Storage Systems
items.text: Health checks, patching, backup verification, and proactive monitoring to keep your core systems stable.

items.title: Networks & Wi-Fi
items.text: Routers, switches, access points, and structured cabling — kept optimized and reliable.

items.title: Printers & Peripherals
items.text: Configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of printers, scanners, and other office peripherals.

items.title: Email & Cloud Services
items.text: Microsoft 365, email account management, and cloud platform support.

items.title: Security & Antivirus
items.text: Endpoint protection updates, firewall checks, and security policy reviews.

items.title: Backup & Recovery
items.text: Backup configuration, monitoring, and recovery support to safeguard your business data.

items.title: Software & License Management
items.text: Installation, updates, and license tracking for your business applications.

blocks.title: Flexible AMC Plans Built Around Your Business
blocks.lead: Choose the level of support that fits how you work.

items.title: Comprehensive AMC
items.text: Full coverage including parts, labor, on-site visits, and remote support. Ideal for businesses that want complete peace of mind with predictable IT costs.

items.title: Non-Comprehensive AMC
items.text: Covers labor, support visits, and troubleshooting — hardware parts billed separately. A cost-effective option for businesses with newer equipment.

items.title: Remote Support AMC
items.text: 24/7 remote helpdesk and online troubleshooting for distributed teams or smaller offices that don't need frequent on-site visits.

items.title: Custom AMC
items.text: Tailored contracts built around your specific infrastructure, locations, response time requirements, and SLA needs.
